evidenceNotes: Lifetime goal: 250,000 overall reported video views by December 31 Eastern. The known 145,434 includes 114,425 newly indexed historical YouTube views. This is expanded coverage, not a Phase 2 surge. Historical paid/organic attribution is unknown.

Known inventory: 93 posts across YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Six private/unlisted YouTube records appear only in the aggregate. YouTube Live archives, X, Twitch, FACEIT and unavailable archives remain uncounted.

Component dates differ: earlier inventory was measured October 11 around 10:18â€“10:20 AM Eastern; new YouTube/TikTok observations around 12:26â€“12:27 PM. Exact dates are in the public dashboard. Views are not unique people.

Measured added views: 957 = 337 YouTube and 68 Instagram baseline changes + 280 earlier TikTok launch views + 115 new Anubis TikTok views + 156 new Anubis YouTube views + 1 new episode view. The latest increment is 272. Startup counts may include operator verification.

The fixed opening baseline is 14,895 YouTube Shorts views and 13,337 Instagram Reel views, measured at 2:51â€“2:53 AM Eastern. The 23-minute start-to-baseline gap and unmeasured growth remain unknown. Native downward revisions are retained.

Anubis is verified public on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, X and Ko-fi. Lab File 003 is public on YouTube. The common planned release was 12:05 PM Eastern; native precision and processing vary. Ko-fi shows only a date, so its exact publication time is unknown.

Next cloud releases: Knife on October 15 at noon Eastern and Door on October 19 at noon Eastern, each on five platforms. Ten future schedules + seven active posts = 17/17. Grouped releases replace daily staggered posts; public archives stay available.
Ko-fi Anubis includes a verified playable YouTube embed. Future Ko-fi posts contain watch links; native embeds can follow verified YouTube publication. Schedules alone do not prove publication.

New timed publications have 4/24/72/168-hour review jobs. First new four-hour checks are due around 4:05 PM Eastern. Ko-fi has a separate conservative observation review around 4:17 PM until its exact time is available. No new winner is established.
Revenue remains unknown pending reconciled payment and refund evidence. Ko-fi financial setup still requests owner location confirmation. Clicks, enquiries and public goal meters are not receipts.
Recorded new spend is $0. Existing equipment, subscriptions and historical promotions are outside this figure. Historical views are not attributed to zero new spend.

Owned Twitch, FACEIT and OBS source indexing remains incomplete. Editing approval used documented sampled visual and technical audio checks; unavailable listening or continuous playback is not claimed. Local operations require this PC online with Codex open.
